description: This file contains diagnostic APIs for MeshAgent components, including functions for gathering system info, network configuration, and connectivity checks for XLE and XB devices, with specific focus on mesh network diagnostics and WFO (WAN Failover) scenarios.

methods.name: getFormattedTime
methods.description: Returns the current local time formatted as a string.

methods.name: check_model
methods.description: Identifies device model based on firmware version.

methods.name: validate_ipv4
methods.description: Validates if a string is a valid IPv4 address.

methods.name: cmd_exec
methods.description: Executes a shell command and captures its output.

methods.name: cmd_ping
methods.description: Pings a destination IP or hostname via specified interface.

methods.name: cmd_ping_root_serv
methods.description: Pings random root servers to check internet connectivity.

methods.name: xmesh_print_dumps
methods.description: Executes a list of diagnostic commands and logs their output.

methods.name: xmesh_xle
methods.description: Performs diagnostics specific to XLE devices, including backhaul, GRE, and internet connectivity checks.

methods.name: xmesh_xb
methods.description: Performs diagnostics specific to XB devices, including mesh configuration, connected pods, GRE tunnels, and internet connectivity.

methods.name: start_diagnostics
methods.description: Thread function that runs periodic diagnostics based on device model.

methods.name: xmesh_diag_start
methods.description: Starts a diagnostics session in a separate thread with specified parameters.

methods.name: xmesh_diag_stop
methods.description: Stops the diagnostics session and outputs aggregated results.
